scope: reconstructed from upstream 17 codes, actual 14 ETFs; exact original E3 identity unavailable; not exact replication
eligibility: at least 273 actual valid close observations through decision date, current valid quote; dynamic after listing
signal_index: causal economic total return index, cash distributions on ex dates and cumulative splits between valid quotes; stop marking values adjust old last close on split

momentum.rank_method: average ties inclusive current value, divided by count
momentum.fewer_than_three: allocate equally to available ranked candidates; no candidates all cash

equal: monthly equal among dynamically eligible symbols, no volatility filter
trend: SMA200 of causal index; after monthly purchase any close below own mean triggers next executable open liquidation; no extra entry filter; no reentry until next monthly selection
timing: complete month-end close decision, next observed union-session open; trades require actual symbol quote and no known block; month boundary stop reconciled into same monthly target, no sell/buy roundtrip
waiting: retain original monthly-only reentry; do not test shorter waiting in this batch
sizing: opening marked equity target, proportional buy-cost budget then lot floor; actual shares drift; completed one-shot orders do not retry to restore weights
corporate_actions: real units and record-date rights; ex-date receivable, pay-date cash; split at market effective day with corresponding marking unit change; nontrade holidays processed
fee_stress: same timing and products, no optimization
metrics: yearly returns with first/last partial labels
qualification: finite source coverage, not official complete corporate-action and suspension database
research_layer: independent allocation extension; not formal A/B/C/D or system road replacement
old_differences: actual units cash accounting vs unresolved old weights method
SMA uses causal continuous economic price index, original price-adjustment status unclear
reference implementation executes next open, old exact implementation missing
industry7 deliberately separate product-class diagnostic, not original pool
